title: Cosmic Melting Clock Cauldron
description: A large cracked white and gold cauldron with gears and dripping substance floats in the center of a swirling cosmic scene. Below it three blue hooded figures with clock faces for heads reach upward with their hands while floating books, hourglasses, gears and vines drift around them against a dark starry background with beams of light and three colored moons above.
